title: QUIT UNLESS
music: Low, brooding political-documentary underscore. Slow pulsing synth bass and muted strings, 80 bpm, tense but restrained, no vocals, no drums, steady bed under narration.

segments.narration: Pay-own-yuh, twenty twenty-four. Voters elect Bill Brunner trustee with sixty-eight percent of the vote. He asks questions. He files records requests.

sfx.prompt: paper ballot dropped into a ballot box

segments.narration: On August first, Town Administrator Stefen Wynn hands in his resignation, with a condition. He will stay, if Brunner is removed.

sfx.prompt: envelope slapped down on a wooden desk

segments.narration: Two weeks later, the board removes Brunner, four to one, for harassment, with no specific incident ever documented in public.

sfx.prompt: single wooden gavel strike in a quiet meeting room

segments.narration: Months later, a planning commissioner asks questions too. Wynn forwards his private emails to every official, calls his work a waste of town resources, and refuses to attend the next meeting unless the board orders him to.

overlays.text: “I will not attend the December 2, 2024 meeting unless required to by the Board of Trustees.”

segments.narration: An unelected administrator, deciding who gets to oversee him.

sfx.prompt: soft deep cinematic boom hit, short

end.source: Sources: Wynn conditional resignation (Aug. 1, 2024); Paonia Board removal hearing, Aug. 13–15, 2024; Wynn emails Sept.–Nov. 2024 (board letter, Mar. 30, 2026)
